0.0: Hi there, if you aren't busy and all, then please hear me out. I have something I really want to drink right now, and I need your help. Can you please help me out?

yes.0: Thanks for saying yes. I am a huge fan of Nependeath Juice, you know. Just thinking about it makes me drool...
yes.1: Elma makes the best Nependeath Juice in all of Orbis. The thing is, she's been refusing to make more for me because I... may have woken her up with my requests a few dozen times.
yes.2: So, would you please go ask #bElma#k to make Nependeath Juice for me? I'm sure she'll make some in a heartbeat if you ask her!
yes.3: So here's the deal. Can you please come up to Ericsson in place of me and get the Nependeath Juice made for me? If you're the one asking, I'm sure he'll say yes to that.

no.0: Please help me out here. If you changed your mind, then please talk to me. I have something I really want to drink.

1.0: What is it? I have a number of things to do.

npc.0: Please go see Elma the Housekeeper. She knows how to make super delicious #bNependeath Juice#k. And, ah, don't mention my name.

QuestInfo.name: The Nependeath Juice
QuestInfo.parent: The Chaos behind Alfonse Green and the Nependeath Juice
QuestInfo.0: I should go see Alfonse Green, who should be somewhere near Orbis.
QuestInfo.1: You met Alfonse Green, noted layabout and lover of Nependeath Juice. Unsurprisingly, he asked you to get Nependeath Juice for him. Find Elma and ask her to make some for you.
